usefulness.rationale: The dossier establishes who Arvind Krishna is (IBM Chairman/CEO) and his career trajectory (IBM Research head, Systems/Technology GM, security software pioneering), supported by a 2022 summit recording and a journalist's encounter. However, it lacks dates for his career progression, conflates an outdated ITIF bio (SVP IBM Research) with his current CEO role without flagging the timeline, and relies heavily on a single interview-encounter source. Board seats and education are covered. Adequate but not deep; timeline ambiguity is a real gap.
